title: Compass, Inc. Provides Board Update and Appoints Technology Executive Sissie Hsiao to Its Board of Directors

body_markdown:
New York, NY – October 14, 2026 – Compass, Inc. ("Compass" or the “Company") (NYSE: COMP), today announced the appointment of Sissie Hsiao to its Board of Directors (“Board”). Ms. Hsiao is a veteran technology executive with more than two decades of experience building and leading consumer technology businesses. During her nearly 20-year tenure at Google, she drove major product innovations, including leading the development of Gemini and applying generative AI, natural language, and speech technologies across Google’s consumer products. Previously, she served as Vice President and General Manager of Google’s Display, Video, and App Advertising businesses.


“Sissie joins our Board at a pivotal time when technology is reshaping how our real estate professionals work. Her AI and advertising background is exactly what we were looking for, and we welcome her to our Board,” said Robert Reffkin, Founder, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Compass.


“Compass has built one of the most recognized collections of brands in real estate and a technology platform that genuinely helps real estate professionals grow their businesses. I’m glad to be joining the Board and looking forward to working with Robert and my fellow directors.” said Ms. Hsiao.


Additionally, effective October 9, 2026, Charles Phillips stepped down from the Board. Mr. Phillips has served as a Director since August 2020 and as Lead Independent Director since February 2021. He also chaired the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee and served as a member of the Audit Committee. Mr. Phillips resigned from the Board to devote more time to other commitments outside the real estate industry, and his resignation was not due to any disagreement with the Company on any matter relating to the Company’s operations, policies, or practices.


“Charles has been an extraordinary partner to this Board and to me personally. As our Lead Independent Director, he brought the judgment of an operator and the discipline of an investor to every conversation. We thank him for his service and wish him continued success. Frank and Steve know our company well, and their continued leadership and deep expertise will serve the Board and our shareholders well,” said Robert Reffkin.


“It’s been an honor to serve as Lead Independent Director on the Compass Board during the Company’s tremendous journey from pre-IPO planning to becoming the largest real estate brokerage in the world. Compass is well positioned to earn strong returns for shareholders by leveraging HOME, the industry’s leading AI platform for real estate professionals and their clients. Robert and his leadership team have done a terrific job building a great company and setting the pace for the industry,” said Mr. Phillips.


Frank Martell succeeds Mr. Phillips as Lead Independent Director. Mr. Martell has served on our Board since November 2021 and is currently the Chairperson of the Audit Committee and a member of the Compensation Committee. He brings more than 30 years of executive leadership experience in single and multifamily real estate, data and analytics as well as scaled technology platforms. Mr. Martell will also continue to serve as President, Chief Executive Officer and a director of SmartRent, Inc.


Steven Sordello succeeds Mr. Phillips as the Chairperson of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. He will also continue to serve on the Audit Committee. Mr. Sordello has served on our Board since November 2020 and is a seasoned public company director well versed in the Company's governance practices.

About Compass


Compass is a leading tech-enabled real estate services company that includes the largest residential real estate brokerage in the United States by sales volume. Founded in 2012 and based in New York City, Compass provides an end-to-end platform that empowers its residential real estate agents at its owned-brokerage to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients. The platform includes an integrated suite of cloud-based software for customer relationship management, marketing, client service, brokerage services, and other critical functionality, all custom-built for the real estate industry. Compass agents utilize the platform to grow their business, save time, and manage their business more efficiently. The Compass network includes Christie's International Real Estate, the world's premier global luxury real estate brand with over 100 independently owned brokerage Affiliates in 50 countries and territories. For more information on how Compass empowers real estate agents, one of the largest groups of small business owners, please visit[www.compass.com](https://www.compass.com/) .
